I am 44, been on this land 20 years. My husband helps when he can but he drives truck most months, so a lot falls on me and my mother-in-law. The two kids are in middle school. 13.1 mu is not small but not big either — every season I have to think carefully where the money goes.

My main rotation is wheat then maize on about 9 mu of the better land near the well. I keep about 4 mu in cotton on the sandier piece — cotton price has been okay and that ground does not hold water well enough for good wheat. I do not plant spring crops, no time and the wheat is still in the ground.

For wheat: I plant in early October after maize comes off. I use Jimai or Shiluan improved seed, whatever the dealer in town has fresh — about 15 kg per mu since I drill it a bit thick, the winter here can be hard. I put down a compound fertilizer 15-15-15 as base, about 50 kg per mu, then topdress urea around jointing in March, maybe 20 kg of urea (so roughly 9 kg N more). Total nitrogen comes to about 17 kg per mu, phosphorus 7-8, potassium 7-8. I irrigate three times — before winter, at jointing, at grain filling. I spray maybe twice, once for aphids and once mixed for rust and wheat midge. Last few years I get around 500 kg per mu, sometimes 550 in a good year.

For maize: Right after wheat harvest in June, no-till direct seed with Zhengdan or Xianyu hybrid, about 2 kg seed per mu. I put compound 15-15-15 at sowing, 40 kg, then sidedress urea at big trumpet stage, 25 kg urea (about 11 kg N). Total N around 17, P and K around 6 each. Maize here only needs irrigation once or twice depending on rain — I plan two. One herbicide spray after seeding, one for borer later. Yield usually 550-600 kg per mu.

For cotton on the 4 mu: I plough that piece because cotton needs deeper soil work. Improved Bt variety, the one the cooperative sells. Cotton eats fertilizer — I put 40 kg compound at planting, then urea twice, total N maybe 18 kg, P 8, K 10 (cotton needs potassium for the bolls). Irrigate 4 times through the season from the well. Pesticide is the headache — even with Bt I still spray 5-6 times for aphids, mirid bugs, spider mites. Yield around 250 kg seed cotton per mu if weather holds.

I always lean a little heavy on fertilizer rather than light. Losing yield hurts more than spending an extra 100 yuan on urea.
